title: Offline Field Inspection App with Photo Evidence and Conflict Handling
description: Lets inspectors fill checklists and attach photos without signal, then syncs to a server and resolves cases where two people edited the same record while offline.

title: Live Caption Display for Conversations
description: Shows large, high-contrast captions from the phone microphone for people with hearing loss, with speaker turns separated by colour and an option to save the transcript locally.

title: Bluetooth Beacon Proximity Notifier
description: Detects nearby Bluetooth beacons in a building and triggers context-aware messages such as room information, while limiting battery drain and repeat notifications.

title: Secure Notes with Biometric Unlock
description: Stores notes encrypted with a key held in the device's secure hardware and unlocked by fingerprint or face, with a safe fallback when biometrics are unavailable.

title: Child Screen-Time Controller with Parental PIN
description: Lets a parent set daily limits per app category, locks the device into a calm screen when time runs out and requires a PIN to extend it, with a simple weekly usage report.

title: Contactless Queue Ticketing App
description: Issues virtual queue tickets for a clinic or office, shows live position and estimated wait, and notifies the user in time to arrive without standing in line.

title: On-Device Plant and Object Classifier with TensorFlow Lite
description: Runs an image classifier fully on the phone so it works without internet, and measures inference time and memory on devices of different ages.

title: Voice Memo Recorder with On-Device Transcription
description: Records meetings, transcribes them locally so audio never leaves the phone, and makes the transcript searchable with timestamps that jump to the matching moment.

title: Step Counter from Raw Accelerometer Signals
description: Counts steps by processing accelerometer data with filtering and peak detection instead of relying on the platform step counter, and checks its accuracy against manual counts.

title: Offline Travel Phrasebook
description: Bundles categorised phrases in several languages with audio and a quick search, working entirely offline so travellers can use it without roaming.

title: Carpool Cost Splitter
description: Calculates fair shares of fuel and toll costs for each passenger from their pickup and drop-off points along a shared route, and keeps a running balance of who owes whom.

title: Sign Language Alphabet Learning Game
description: Teaches a hand-shape alphabet through short lessons and quizzes, using the camera to check that the learner's hand matches the target shape and tracking progress per letter.

title: Battery-Aware Background Sync Scheduler
description: Schedules background uploads according to battery level, network type and charging state, and compares battery cost against a naive fixed-interval sync on a test device.

title: Universal Link Router for a Content App
description: Opens the right screen when a user taps a web link to an article or profile, handling logged-out users, missing content and the case where the app is not installed.

title: Digital Student ID Wallet Card
description: Presents a student's ID as a card with a rotating code that gate readers can verify, working offline for short periods and revoking cards that are reported lost.

title: Location-Based Task Reminders
description: Reminds the user of a task when they arrive at or leave a place, such as buying milk near a shop, using geofences that avoid draining the battery.

title: Time Zone Meeting Planner
description: Finds meeting times that fall within reasonable working hours for people in several time zones and shows clearly who would be joining at an awkward hour.

title: Private Mood Journal with Local Encryption
description: Lets a user log mood and short notes, view trends over weeks and keep everything encrypted on the device, with no account and no claim to diagnose anything.

title: GPS Track Recorder with Elevation Profile
description: Records a walking or cycling route, smooths noisy GPS points and shows distance, pace and an elevation profile, saving tracks for later comparison.

title: Bus Stop Announcer for Visually Impaired Riders
description: Announces approaching stops and nearby landmarks through audio using location and schedule data, with large controls and full screen-reader support.

title: Shake-to-Report Bug Reporter Library
description: Provides a small library that lets testers shake the phone to capture a screenshot, device details and recent logs and send them as a ready-made bug report.

title: Batching Telemetry Library for Mobile Analytics
description: Collects usage events on the device, batches and compresses them, retries on failure and respects user consent, with tests for flaky networks and process kills.

title: Design System Demo with Dynamic Type and Dark Mode
description: Builds a small component library that adapts to system text size and dark mode, with screenshots that show every component at the largest accessibility settings.

title: Localisation Pipeline with Pseudo-Locale Testing
description: Extracts strings for translation, generates a pseudo-locale that stretches text and adds accents, and uses it in tests to catch truncated labels and hard-coded strings.

title: Smartwatch Interval Timer Companion
description: Runs workout interval timers on a watch with haptic cues, syncing sessions to a phone app that stores history and lets the user design new interval plans.

title: Adaptive Split-View Notes App for Tablets
description: Adapts a notes app to phones, tablets and foldables with list and detail panes that rearrange as the window size changes, preserving selection state through resizes.

title: Review Prompt Timing Experiment
description: Tests when to ask users to rate an app by showing the prompt after different events, and compares prompt acceptance rates without interrupting people mid-task.
